clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Tsunaman watches the currents of Kalimdor for signs of unrest. He works with the Horde against forces that threaten the waters.

Near the path from Sun Rock Retreat down to the Charred Vale, Tsunaman serves the Tribunal of the Tides, high-ranking servants aligned with the Tidehunter, Neptulon. He works with the Horde to watch for elemental unrest throughout Kalimdor, especially disturbances spreading from the submerged caverns of Blackfathom Deeps.

Tsunaman hates fire in every form. The burning lands of the Charred Vale and incursions by fire elementals keep him fuming. Around camp, he sometimes marches to nearby cooking fires and campfires and smacks them out with a heavy fist of water.
